snippet.title: Echoes of Mora - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
🎁 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/31...

🌊 What is Echoes of Mora?
Echoes of Mora is a mystery narrative adventure for PC-VR and PC.
Swim through a sunken, abandoned village, find hidden objects, and travel back in time, where you witness the last days before the flood.
Along the way, you'll meet a girl named Mora and help her find her missing brother, before everything changes.

🦭 About Selkies Interactive
Founded in 2023 by game design students in Berlin, Selkies Interactive creates immersive story-driven worlds. Their debut title "Echoes of Mora" is part of the Games Incubator at HTW Berlin and supported by Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg.

🎶 Echoes of Mora Soundtrack by: https://www.youtube.com/@FedericoTruzzi
